St. Sous fameang 10.62

Dear Sei

noh breu paco and sa te sanel g ne tir antie ne devine inputone, inpotone, mul hante yor if istu you patri ditu me whithu Valnu Bean Vacker hane any clam ajit geveve i sik to whew čel se la pánis tin Malmen nefert sue wred hay

1 lh mone

as rino . Afte my

obre siánțen. de c muho eomo jer ne

i dung war tener,

id ince lee excading y

kai

My dup ansee

fai Ito boce thie chelt . w vegar zo ther, alenil mey

lash resone, sul

excuse thi treble. The committee will meeh again on Jusday evening at veven. Onclosed

lay handy de arense
